label: Alternate appearances for comparison sheets
description: A second donor per race and sex, built only for side-by-side comparison sheets and never shipped as playable. Kept in config so the sheet is reproducible; its GLBs go to output/sheet-variants/, which the game does not read.
referenceNotes: No reference build: sheet variants reuse the playable roster's rig and manifest and are always built with --skip-reference.
